articles.title: USS Stout Loses Power During Port Visit Due to ‘Engineering Casualty’
articles.summary: A deployed destroyer recently lost power during a port visit to Italy, USNI News understands. USS Stout (DDG-55) was in port in Augusta Bay, Italy, for a scheduled port visit on Oct. 25 when it experienced an engineering casualty, causing the ship to lose power, Cmdr. Lauren Spaziano, U.S. 6th Fleet spokesperson, told USNI News.

articles.title: 54th QM Co. Soldiers deploy to CENTCOM AOR
articles.summary: More than 25 Soldiers assigned to Detachment 1, 54th Quartermaster Company (Fatality Management), 10th Transportation Battalion (Terminal), 7th Transportation Brigade (Expeditionary) were recognized in a deployment ceremony Nov. 2 at the Fort Lee Family Life Center as they prepare to deploy to the U.S.
